findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/evidence/environment-contract.ts:544 — HIGH: producer trust is self-asserted by the receipt: normalization accepts verificationSource=verifier-owned-attestation-registry plus signatureVerified=true without resolving a verifier-owned registry, signature, or key binding; evaluateEvidenceEnvironmentGateProjection then hard-codes environmentDescriptorValid/environmentReceiptValid/environmentPolicyValid to true. A caller can therefore mint two invented lineage/key/session tuples, normalize both, and satisfy evaluateEvidenceEnvironmentQuorum. WHY: this contradicts the identity-bound, forged-producer fail-closed invariant and makes host-independence evidence forgeable.

packages/main/src/core/evidence/environment-contract.ts:793 — HIGH: M5 is described as actual lifecycle Gate integration, but evaluateEvidenceEnvironmentGateProjection is referenced only by the smoke test and no REVIEW/TEST/DONE state-machine consumer invokes it. The new process-fact entry merely names a consumer; it does not make the receipt gate-consumed. WHY: the public support matrix currently upgrades a pure library projection to an implemented lifecycle-control claim, leaving the Story/Release combination gap unchanged.

docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-environment-adapter-execution-plan.md:62,936-942 claims the EEA mechanism is integrated/demonstrated at a lifecycle Gate, but repository call-site search shows evaluateEvidenceEnvironmentGateProjection is referenced only by exports, process-fact declarations, and packages/main/src/tasks/evidence-environment-adapter-smoke.ts; no TEST/DONE/storyMachine or other production lifecycle Gate consumes normalized EEA receipts. The smoke directly calls the helper with fabricated checks, so it proves the helper projection, not M5 actual Gate integration. WHY: the paper must remain at Level B and CHK-006/M5 is incomplete until a real configured lifecycle Gate consumer invokes the projection and a test exercises that consumer end-to-end.

docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-environment-adapter-execution-plan.md:907-910 requires an exact manuscript artifact path/version plus implementation commit or release digest before M6 is complete, but the repository only names the existing arXiv identifier in README and does not bind a manuscript revision/artifact to the B-955c implementation commit/release; CHK-005 is nevertheless marked done. WHY: the handoff cannot yet satisfy its own audit rule, and an external editor cannot tell which manuscript version contains the calibrated EEA claim. Record the exact manuscript target/version and binding digest, or explicitly leave M6/CHK-005 incomplete and state that current claims are repository-document-only.
